fields.title: Cell
fields.label: We study how aging unfolds inside single cells, where coordinated programs and stochastic drift both leave a mark. The work spans single-cell epigenetic aging, the stem and progenitor cells of the long-lived naked mole-rat, clonal B cells that expand with age and drive lymphoma, and foundation models for single-cell data.
